identity.normalization: ID-2: packet split 'Aqua (Water' and 'Eau)' into raw entries 1-2; merged into one entry 'Aqua (Water, Eau)' before numbering, so normalized position = raw position - 1 from Sodium Laureth Sulfate onward. All positions cited are normalized.

cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate by C1: defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate @2, prominent buffer Cocamidopropyl Betaine @3, no reinforcing strong anionic.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: C2 is not met only because the humectant element is missing (no Glycerin, Panthenol, Sodium Hyaluronate, Sodium PCA, Urea, Sorbitol or Betaine anywhere); the other three elements are present: early silicone Dimethicone @7 (prominent), cationic polymer Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride @12 and pearlizing route Glycol Distearate @14. Without C2 the anchors decide: one meaningful silicone/cationic system (Dimethicone @7, Amodimethicone @11, guar @12) plus light routes (Hydrolyzed Keratin @6, PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate @5, Hydrogenated Castor Oil @13) is moderate. Per C2 the missing humectant is the counter-signal and high is the neighbor.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: Missing C2 humectant element (no closed-list humectant).

payload_lipid: Hydrogenated Castor Oil @13 (waxy; non-material, after W-line 8)

wLine.plausibility: (i) Sodium Laureth Sulfate @2 before it; (ii) nothing between @8 and the cap @9.

weightPotential.w1Check: W1 does not apply: (a) and (b) hold (C1 SLES/betaine chassis; Dimethicone @7 + Guar @12 + late Amodimethicone @11), but (c) fails because a protein film (Hydrolyzed Keratin @6, prominent) reinforces the set; the full method decides. The lipids are non-material (W-line @8) and do not end W1.
weightPotential.depositionLoad: moderate: prominent dimethicone plus amodimethicone and cationic guar (coacervate system) with a prominent keratin film and a weak refatter.
weightPotential.persistence: moderate-to-high: dimethicone and amodimethicone are persistent and amodimethicone binds to damaged sites; guar aids deposition.
weightPotential.counterevidence: Convergence route of the high anchor is formally present (silicone, cationic_polymer, protein_film are three families, all counted wherever listed); waxy Hydrogenated Castor Oil @13 and Apricot Kernel Oil @20 would add a lipid leg if they were material.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Moderate: a persistent silicone/amodimethicone/guar system with a keratin film plausibly leaves noticeable but bounded residue.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not high: the deposition is the W1-type silicone/guar/amodimethicone set plus a light protein, with no rich architecture: the lipids that could make it rich (Hydrogenated Castor Oil @13, Apricot Kernel Oil @20) are at or after the W-line @8 and are non-material, and the moderate C1 reset is not limited. Because a post-line payload lipid is part of what keeps it from high, confidence is capped at moderate with high as neighbor (W-LINE item 6). Not low: silicone plus cationic polymer plus protein (W2) is clearly more than a light route.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Silicone and amodimethicone dose unknown; the formula sits near the moderate/high boundary (W-LINE item 6 cap).
weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: W1 excluded by the keratin film, full method gives moderate (persistent silicone/guar system, non-material lipids, moderate reset); high is the neighbor.
weightPotential.counterSignal: Convergence route of the high anchor is formally present (silicone, cationic_polymer, protein_film are three families, all counted wherever listed); waxy Hydrogenated Castor Oil @13 and Apricot Kernel Oil @20 would add a lipid leg if they were material.
